opts.doc: A unique identifier is used to manage state and interaction
Determines the style
Determines color theme
Determines border style
Determines the border radius
Space between items
Determines custom class for the font weight
Determines padding for items
Custom CSS class for additional styling
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

components.body:
radius = (assigns.size - assigns.thickness) / 2
circumference = 2 * :math.pi() * radius
progress_fraction = (assigns.max > 0 && assigns.value / assigns.max) || 0
dash_offset = circumference * (1 - progress_fraction)

assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign(:radius, radius)
  |> assign(:circumference, circumference)
  |> assign(:dash_offset, dash_offset)

demo_examples.raw_source:
<.filterable_gallery
              cols="four"
              class="mt-10"
              id="my-gallery"
              default_filter="All Categories"
              filters={["Sky", "Flowers", "Sea", "Boat"]}
              media={[
                %{src: "/images/card-5.jpg", alt: "Sea 1", category: ["Sea", "Boat"]},
                %{src: "/images/card-6.jpg", alt: "Sky 1", category: "Sky"},
                %{src: "/images/card-7.jpg", alt: "Flowers 1", category: "Flowers"},
                %{src: "/images/card-8.jpg", alt: "Flowers 2", category: "Flowers"},
                %{src: "/images/card-9.jpg", alt: "Sky 2", category: ["Sky", "Sea"]},
                %{src: "/images/card-11.jpg", alt: "Sea 2", category: ["Sea", "Boat"]},
                %{src: "/images/card-10.jpg", alt: "Flowers 3", category: "Flowers"}
              ]}
            >
              <:filter :let={filter}>
                <button
                  data-gallery-filter
                  data-category={filter}
                  class="py-2.5 px-6 text-sm rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600  to-indigo-400 shadow-indigo-500/50 text-white cursor-pointer font-semibold text-center shadow-xs dark:shadow-none transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-gradient-to-l disabled:text-[#BBBBBB]  dark:disabled:text-[#868686] disabled:from-[#F3F3F3] disabled:to-[#F3F3F3] dark:disabled:from-[#4B4B4B] dark:disabled:to-[#4B4B4B] disabled:shadow-none"
                >
                  {filter}
                </button>
              </:filter>
              <:media_block :let={media}>
                <.gallery_media rounded="large" src={media.src} alt={media.alt} />
              </:media_block>
            </.filterable_gallery>

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn -> field.name end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> range_field()

opts.doc: The unique identifier for the clipboard component element.
CSS classes to apply to the clipboard component container.
The text to copy to the clipboard. If not provided, it will look for the text content or target selector.
The CSS selector for the target element to copy from, if no text is provided.
The timeout duration (in milliseconds) before the clipboard operation is considered failed.
CSS class applied to the component when the clipboard copy is successful.
CSS class applied to the component when the clipboard copy fails.
The success message to display after a successful copy operation.
The error message to display after a failed copy operation.
Label for the button used to trigger the copy operation.
Optional description text for screen readers, providing more context about the clipboard functionality.
CSS class for styling the status message shown after a copy operation.
CSS class for styling the content shown in the clipboard container.
CSS class for styling the trigger wrapper.
If true, displays the visual clipboard status text (e.g., 'Copied!'). Default: true.
If true, replaces text inside `.clipboard-label` on copy success/failure. Default: false.
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

components.body:
assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "clipboard-#{random_id()}" end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_success_text, fn -> gettext("Copied!") end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_error_text, fn -> gettext("Copy failed") end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_button_label, fn -> gettext("Copy to clipboard") end)
  |> then(fn new_assigns ->
    new_assigns
    |> assign(:status_id, "#{new_assigns.id}-status")
    |> assign(:content_id, "#{new_assigns.id}-content")
  end)

helpers.code:
total_pages = max(total, 0)
total_page_numbers = siblings * 2 + 3 + boundaries * 2

pagination_range =
  if total_page_numbers >= total_pages do
    range(1, total_pages)
  else
    left_sibling_index = max(current_page - siblings, boundaries + 1)
    right_sibling_index = min(current_page + siblings, total_pages - boundaries)
    should_show_left_dots = left_sibling_index > boundaries + 2
    should_show_right_dots = right_sibling_index < total_pages - boundaries - 1
    dots = :dots

    cond do
      !should_show_left_dots and should_show_right_dots ->
        left_item_count = siblings * 2 + boundaries + 2
        range(1, left_item_count) ++ [dots] ++ range(total_pages - boundaries + 1, total_pages)

      should_show_left_dots and not should_show_right_dots ->
        right_item_count = boundaries + 1 + 2 * siblings
        range(1, boundaries) ++ [dots] ++ range(total_pages - right_item_count + 1, total_pages)

      true ->
        range(1, boundaries) ++
          [dots] ++
          range(left_sibling_index, right_sibling_index) ++
          [dots] ++ range(total_pages - boundaries + 1, total_pages)
    end
  end

%{range: pagination_range(current_page, pagination_range), active: current_page}

if active != 1 and (active - 1) not in range do
  index = Enum.find_index(range, &(&1 == active))
  List.insert_at(range, index, active - 1)
else
  range
end

components.template:
<kbd
  id={@id}
  class={[
    "px-2 py-1.5",
    color_variant(@variant, @color),
    size_class(@size),
    border_class(@border, @variant),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    @font_weight,
    @class
  ]}
  {@rest}
>
  {render_slot(@inner_block)}
</kbd>

The drawer integrates seamlessly with Phoenix LiveView, offering interactive functionality through JavaScript actions for showing, hiding, and reacting to events such as clicking outside the drawer.               <.cp class="p-3">
                The Mishka Chelekom Drawer component is a highly customizable and flexible sliding panel for Phoenix LiveView applications. It allows developers to add content in a side or top/bottom drawer, which can be toggled to show or hide based on user interactions. With built-in support for different positions like left, right, top, and bottom, the drawer can fit into a variety of layouts and use cases. It also provides several customization options, including size, color, and styling variants, making it adaptable to different design needs. The drawer integrates seamlessly with Phoenix LiveView, offering interactive functionality through JavaScript actions for showing, hiding, and reacting to events such as clicking outside the drawer. This makes the Mishka Chelekom Drawer component a practical and essential tool for creating smooth, user-friendly navigation and interactive elements in web applications.
              </.cp>
            </.drawer>

assigns.page_title: Checkbox card - Chelekom Phoenix & LiveView component

demo_examples.raw_source:
<.form_wrapper
              for={@form}
              id="user-form"
              phx-change="validate"
              phx-submit="save"
              space="medium"
            >
              <.h5>Full Name</.h5>
              <.text_field size="medium" field={@form[:fullname]} />

              <.h5>Select your area of expertise</.h5>

              <.radio_card field={@form[:job]} cols="three" size="extra_small" class="text-center">
                <:radio
                  :for={item <- Ecto.Enum.values(User, :job)}
                  value={"#{item}"}
                  checked={radio_check(:list, {:job, "#{item}"}, @form)}
                  title={String.capitalize("#{item}")}
                  icon={radio_card_icons("#{item}")}
                >
                </:radio>
              </.radio_card>

              <.h5>What is your hobbies?</.h5>

              <.checkbox_card
                field={@form[:hobbies]}
                cols="three"
                size="extra_small"
                class="text-center"
                variant="bordered"
                color="natural"
              >
                <:checkbox
                  value="reading"
                  title="Reading"
                  icon="hero-book-open"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "reading"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="programming"
                  icon="hero-computer-desktop"
                  title="Programming"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "programming"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="photography"
                  icon="hero-camera"
                  title="Photography"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "photography"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
              </.checkbox_card>
              <hr class="border-b h-[1px] border-[#E5E7EB] dark:border-gray-500" />

              <.h5>Do you accept terms and conditions?</.h5>
              <.toggle_field
                field={@form[:accepted_terms]}
                checked={toggle_check(:accepted_terms, @form)}
                color="info"
                phx-debounce="300"
              />

              <:actions>
                <.button variant="outline" color="info" size="small" phx-disable-with="Saving...">
                  Save User
                </.button>
              </:actions>
            </.form_wrapper>

assigns = assigns |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "accordion-#{random_id()}" end)

items_with_ids =
  assigns.item
  |> Enum.with_index(1)
  |> Enum.map(fn {item, index} ->
    if item[:id] do
      item
    else
      Map.put(item, :id, "#{assigns.id}-item-#{index}")
    end
  end)

assigns = assign(assigns, :item, items_with_ids)

<.accordion
              id="chelekom-accordion-multiple-open"
              variant="bordered_separated"
              color="primary"
              multiple={true}
              initial_open={["item1", "item3"]}
            >
              <:item
                id="item1"
                title="First Item (Initially Open)"
                icon="hero-document-text"
                icon_class="size-[17px] text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-300"
              >
                This is the first accordion item that is initially open. It demonstrates how you can have specific items expanded when the accordion loads.
              </:item>

              <:item
                id="item2"
                title="Second Item (Initially Closed)"
                icon="hero-cog-6-tooth"
                icon_class="size-[17px] text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-300"
              >
                This item starts closed and can be opened by clicking the trigger. The accordion supports multiple items being open simultaneously.
              </:item>

              <:item
                id="item3"
                title="Third Item (Initially Open)"
                icon="hero-star"
                icon_class="size-[17px] text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-300"
              >
                This is another initially open item. You can specify multiple items to be open by including their IDs in the initial_open array.
              </:item>

              <:item
                id="item4"
                title="Fourth Item (Initially Closed)"
                icon="hero-heart"
                icon_class="size-[17px] text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-300"
              >
                This final item demonstrates the complete flexibility of the accordion component with multiple items and mixed initial states.

Event name pushed to the server when a new option is created
Determines the overall size of the elements, including padding, font size, and other items
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

components.body:
assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "combo-#{random_id()}" end)
  |> assign_new(:name, fn -> nil end)
  |> assign_new(:options, fn -> [] end)
  |> assign_new(:option, fn -> [] end)
  |> assign_new(:value, fn -> Map.get(assigns, :value, []) end)
  |> then(fn a ->
    if a.creatable do
      assign(a, :searchable, true)
    else
      a
    end
  end)

{@description}
<.component component_name="chelekom-scroll-area" site={assigns[:site]} id={"combobox-wrapper-#{@id}"} padding="none" height={@height} scrollbar_width="w-[4px]" >
<.option :for={{label, value} <- @options} :if={@options} value={value}> {label}
{group_label}

{gettext("Nothing found!")}

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.multiple do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> combobox()

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn -> field.name end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> radio_card()

helpers.code:
if params[Atom.to_string(field)] do
  new_value =
    if is_atom(value) do
      Atom.to_string(value)
    else
      value
    end

  new_value == params[Atom.to_string(field)]
else
  Map.get(data, field) == value
end

helpers.code:
errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.rest[:multiple] do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> file_field()

<%= for entry <- @entries do %>
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site={assigns[:site]} name="hero-document-arrow-up" class="size-8" />
{entry.client_name}
{convert_to_mb(entry.client_size)} MB
<.component component_name="chelekom-progress" site={assigns[:site]} value={entry.progress} color={@color} size="extra_small" /> {gettext("Uploading %{file}: %{progress} percent", file: entry.client_name, progress: entry.progress )}
<%= for err <- upload_errors(@upload_error, entry) do %>

Error: {error_to_string(err)}

<% end %>
<% end %>

components.template:
<video
  id={@id}
  class={[
    width_class(@width),
    height_class(@height),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    aspect_ratio(@ratio),
    caption_size(@caption_size),
    caption_background(@caption_background),
    caption_opacity(@caption_opacity),
    @class
  ]}
  poster={@thumbnail}
  {@rest}
>
  <source :for={source <- @source} src={source.src} type={source.type} />

  <track
    :for={track <- @track}
    src={track.src}
    label={track.label || "English"}
    kind={track.kind || "subtitles"}
    srclang={track.srclang || "en"}
    default={track.default}
  />

  {gettext("Your browser does not support the video tag.")}
</video>

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

select =
  case field.value do
    val when is_integer(val) ->
      val

    val when is_float(val) ->
      val

    val when is_binary(val) and val != "" ->
      case Float.parse(val) do
        {f, ""} ->
          if f == trunc(f) do
            trunc(f)
          else
            f
          end

        _ ->
          0
      end

    _ ->
      0
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign(:name, field.name)
|> assign(:select, select)
|> assign(
  :interactive,
  if assigns.disabled do
    false
  else
    true
  end
)
|> rating()

components.template:
<input
  type={@type}
  id={@id}
  value={@value}
  class={[
    default_classes(@rest[:pinging], false),
    size_class(@size, @rest[:circle]),
    color_variant(@variant, @color, false),
    content_position(@content_position),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    border_size(@border, @variant),
    @full_width && "w-full",
    @font_weight,
    @line_height,
    @display,
    @class
  ]}
  {@rest}
/>

|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> textarea_field()
